note: On the shore of Lake Renwick about 5 mi west of Cavalier: West, South and North modern loops of gravel pull-throughs among oaks and shelterbelts, and a primitive loop on an open grass meadow across from the Hillman trailhead. Swim beach, boat ramp and paddle-craft rentals; the Pioneer Heritage Center and the Gunlogson Nature Preserve trails are in the park. Three camping cabins. --Claude
summary: Park page + reserveNDparks: 153 sites (136 modern 30/50-amp + water $25/$30 Sat, 7 modern group, 10 primitive grass meadow sites $15 that take an RV), showers, flush toilets, dump; base $15 stands. Electric 50, max_rig 82, count 153 confirmed; groups manual; note trimmed. Waterfront lakeview is weak (nearest pads ~60 m behind a continuous wooded shore band): downgrade lead to not waterfront. Pin ~215 m from the site centroid (under threshold).
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (stored lakeview, not --AWH; suggest DOWNGRADE to not waterfront under the unsure-goes-down rule): the campground is on a point of Lake Renwick, but on imagery (leaf-off) every loop is separated from the lake by a continuous band of deciduous woodland and brush. Closest pads: West loop 17 (48.78269,-97.76171) ~60 m, 29 (48.78025,-97.76131) ~60 m, 24 and 26 (48.7810,-97.7622 / 48.7807,-97.7621) ~95-100 m, and South loop 72-75 (~48.7775,-97.7580) ~80-85 m from the open water; DEM ~296-300 m at the pads, ~296 m at the lake, so no elevated vantage. Leaf-off the water shows through bare trunks; with summer leaves the band is a screen, and the reservation system has no site photos and no water tags. No site can earn lakefront (wooded buffer); lakeview is not supported by any official photo.

MAX LENGTH: reserveNDparks Pad Length = VehicleLength on modern sites (35-82 ft, not uniform: looks real). North loop double site 120 posts 16 ft and 118 posts 23 ft (pull-through double sites, almost certainly data errors). Primitive meadow sites post Pad Width 50 on all ten and lengths 35-70 (the width is a placeholder). 151 of 152 bookable sites take 23 ft.

BASE: primitive $15 sites are 'Primitive Campsite' units flagged IsRVSite true with RV sleeping units, grass meadow, 35-70 ft, so a 23-ft motorhome may use them; base $15 stands. POLICY ROW consistent (Saturday +$5 on modern only; primitive $15 every night). Stored reservation_fee/entrance duplicate the state:ND row; left as stored.
COUNT: park page 136 modern + 7 group + 10 primitive = 153; reserveNDparks lists 135 modern + 7 double + 10 primitive = 152.
